record.name: Front
record.one_liner: Front is a customer service and operations platform featuring a Core API, webhooks, and MCP server for building integrations.

auth.notes: Front supports OAuth 2.0 as well as API Tokens (API Tokens / API keys).

access.notes: Developers can create a developer account by signing up directly to access a free developer environment and APIs.

api_surface.notes: Front provides a Core API, webhooks, MCP Server, Connectors, Plugin SDK, and Channel API.

mcp.notes: Front offers an MCP Server that allows AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT to read and reply to conversations and other Front resources.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (oauth2) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)

evidence.claim: Developers can sign up for a developer account and free developer environment themselves.

evidence.claim: Front supports OAuth 2.0 and API Tokens for authentication.

evidence.claim: Front provides an MCP Server to access data and actions through the MCP protocol.
evidence.quote: Access Front data and actions through the MCP protocol, allowing AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT to read and reply to conversations and other Front resources.

evidence.claim: Front provides webhooks in addition to the Core API.
evidence.quote: Our webhooks also make it possible to respond to real-time events as actions and updates happen in Front.
